natural: Eight or nine out of ten

meaning.en: Most likely; in all probability.
meaning.zh: 指绝大多数，或指可能性很大。

examples.zh: 他这么晚还没来，十有八九是堵车了。
examples.en: He's still not here this late — ten to one he's stuck in traffic.

examples.zh: 这种广告十有八九是骗人的。
examples.en: Ads like this are a scam nine times out of ten.

natural: Picked up with a casual hand

meaning.en: To produce effortlessly; to have at one's fingertips.
meaning.zh: 随手拿来。形容写文章时能自如地运用词汇或材料。

equivalents: off the top of one's head

examples.zh: 他学识渊博，引经据典信手拈来。
examples.en: He's so learned that he quotes the classics off the top of his head.

examples.zh: 这些例子对她来说信手拈来。
examples.en: She has these examples at her fingertips.

natural: The whole army wiped out

meaning.en: Wiped out to the last man; a total defeat.
meaning.zh: 整个军队全部被消灭。比喻彻底失败。

examples.zh: 这一仗敌军全军覆没。
examples.en: The enemy was annihilated in this battle.

examples.zh: 我们班参加比赛的五个人全军覆没，一个都没获奖。
examples.en: All five from our class were knocked out — not one won a prize.

usage.en: Predicate. Military or humorous everyday use.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可用于战争或幽默地用于日常。

natural: A battle with a river at one's back

meaning.en: A last-ditch fight with no way to retreat.
meaning.zh: 背靠江河作战，没有退路。比喻在不利情况下和敌人决一死战，也比喻做最后一次努力。

examples.zh: 这是决赛前最后一场，球队只能背水一战。
examples.en: It's the last match before the final — the team must win or go home.

examples.zh: 公司资金快用完了，这次融资是背水一战。
examples.en: The company is almost out of money; this funding round is make-or-break.

story.en: General Han Xin deliberately camped his troops with a river at their backs. With nowhere to flee, they fought desperately and defeated a much larger Zhao army.
story.zh: 韩信攻赵，背水列阵，士兵无路可退，拼死作战，大破赵军。

usage.en: Predicate or object. In speech 一 is yí.

natural: Strike the iron while it's hot

meaning.en: To strike while the iron is hot; to seize the moment.
meaning.zh: 趁着铁烧红的时候锤打。比喻抓紧有利时机，加速进行。

equivalents: strike while the iron is hot
make hay while the sun shines

examples.zh: 刚学完的内容要趁热打铁，马上复习。
examples.en: Strike while the iron is hot and revise what you've just learned straight away.

examples.zh: 新产品反响很好，公司趁热打铁推出了第二款。
examples.en: The new product was well received, so the company struck while the iron was hot and launched a second.

usage.en: Predicate. Same image as the English idiom.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。与英语习语意象相同。

natural: In such pain one doesn't want to live

meaning.en: Grief-stricken; in such pain that one wishes to die.
meaning.zh: 悲痛得不想活下去。形容悲痛到极点。

examples.zh: 失去孩子后，她痛不欲生。
examples.en: After losing her child, she was inconsolable.

examples.zh: 牙疼起来真是痛不欲生。
examples.en: Toothache can be absolute agony.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指悲痛或夸张地指疼痛。

natural: A gentle breeze and beautiful sunshine

meaning.en: Fine, sunny weather with a gentle breeze.
meaning.zh: 微风和煦，阳光明丽。形容晴朗暖和的天气。

examples.zh: 周末风和日丽，我们去公园野餐吧。
examples.en: It's beautiful weather this weekend — let's have a picnic in the park.

examples.zh: 在一个风和日丽的早晨，他们出发了。
examples.en: They set off on a fine, sunny morning.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Very common in school writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，作文常用。

natural: Going round and starting again

meaning.en: To go round in cycles; to repeat over and over.
meaning.zh: 转了一圈又一圈，不断循环。

examples.zh: 春夏秋冬，周而复始。
examples.en: Spring, summer, autumn, winter — round and round they go.

examples.zh: 每天上班下班，周而复始，他觉得很无聊。
examples.en: Going to work and coming home in an endless cycle, he felt bored.

natural: Going forward with nothing able to stop it

meaning.en: To press forward fearlessly; indomitable.
meaning.zh: 一直向前，无可阻挡。形容不怕困难，勇往直前。

examples.zh: 他们以一往无前的精神完成了任务。
examples.en: They completed the task with undaunted spirit.

examples.zh: 认准了目标，就要一往无前。
examples.en: Once you're sure of your goal, press on regardless.

natural: Riding on victory to pursue the enemy

meaning.en: To press home an advantage; to follow up a success.
meaning.zh: 趁着胜利的形势继续追击敌人。也比喻趁有利形势扩大成果。

examples.zh: 上半场领先后，主队乘胜追击，又进两球。
examples.en: Leading at half time, the home team pressed home their advantage with two more goals.

examples.zh: 新店开张大获成功，公司乘胜追击，又开了三家。
examples.en: After the first shop's success, the company followed up by opening three more.

natural: Gentle, cultured and refined

meaning.en: Gentle, cultured and refined in manner.
meaning.zh: 态度温和，举止文雅。

examples.zh: 王教授温文尔雅，从不对学生发脾气。
examples.en: Professor Wang is refined and gentle and never loses his temper with students.

examples.zh: 她说话温文尔雅，很有修养。
examples.en: She speaks with grace and is very cultivated.

natural: Troubles at home and threats abroad

meaning.en: Troubles at home and threats from abroad.
meaning.zh: 国内的动乱和外来的祸患。也泛指内部和外部的困难。

examples.zh: 清朝末年，中国内忧外患。
examples.en: In the late Qing, China was beset by trouble at home and abroad.

examples.zh: 公司内忧外患，既有内部矛盾，又有激烈竞争。
examples.en: The company is beset on all sides — internal conflict and fierce competition.

natural: Feelings surging like a tide

meaning.en: Deeply stirred; emotions surging.
meaning.zh: 心里像浪潮翻腾。形容心情十分激动。

examples.zh: 看到国旗升起，我心潮澎湃。
examples.en: Watching the flag rise, I was stirred to the core.

examples.zh: 站在长城上，他心潮澎湃。
examples.en: Standing on the Great Wall, he was overcome with emotion.

natural: Weighing every catty

meaning.en: To haggle over every little thing; petty and calculating.
meaning.zh: 形容过分计较微小的利益或无关紧要的事情。

examples.zh: 朋友之间不要斤斤计较。
examples.en: Don't be petty between friends.

examples.zh: 他连一块钱都斤斤计较。
examples.en: He haggles over every single yuan.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用否定劝诫。

natural: Good fortune and everything as you wish

meaning.en: Good luck and every wish fulfilled (a greeting).
meaning.zh: 吉利顺心，事事如意。常用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 祝您新年吉祥如意！
examples.en: Wishing you good fortune in the New Year!

examples.zh: 窗上贴着写有"吉祥如意"的剪纸。
examples.en: Paper cuts with "good fortune" on them decorate the window.

usage.en: Greeting; predicate after 祝……. Common at New Year.

natural: Facing danger without fear

meaning.en: Fearless in the face of danger.
meaning.zh: 遇到危险一点也不害怕。

equivalents: brave in the face of danger

examples.zh: 面对持刀歹徒，保安临危不惧。
examples.en: Faced with a knife-wielding attacker, the guard was cool under fire.

examples.zh: 他临危不惧，指挥大家有序撤离。
examples.en: Fearless in the face of danger, he directed an orderly evacuation.

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 沉着冷静.

natural: One cry that startles everyone

meaning.en: To achieve sudden, striking success after obscurity.
meaning.zh: 比喻平时没有突出表现，一下子做出惊人的成绩。

examples.zh: 这位新人导演的处女作一鸣惊人。
examples.en: The new director burst onto the scene with a stunning debut.

examples.zh: 他平时默默无闻，没想到一鸣惊人。
examples.en: He'd always kept a low profile — no one expected such a dramatic success.

story.en: King Wei of Qi spent three years in idle pleasure. Chunyu Kun asked him about a bird that neither flew nor sang. The king replied: "Once it flies it will soar to the sky; once it sings it will startle everyone" — and he set about reforming the state.
story.zh: 齐威王沉湎享乐，淳于髡以"大鸟三年不飞不鸣"相问。齐威王说："此鸟不飞则已，一飞冲天；不鸣则已，一鸣惊人。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 不鸣则已. In speech 一 is yì.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"不鸣则已"连用。

natural: Heard on the road, repeated on the way

meaning.en: Hearsay; rumours picked up and passed on.
meaning.zh: 路上听来的又在路上传播。泛指没有根据的传闻。

equivalents: I heard it on the grapevine

examples.zh: 这些都是道听途说，不能当真。
examples.en: This is all hearsay — don't take it seriously.

examples.zh: 写新闻不能根据道听途说的消息。
examples.en: News shouldn't be based on hearsay.

story.en: Confucius: "To hear something on the road and repeat it on the way is to abandon virtue" (道听而涂说，德之弃也).
story.zh: 《论语·阳货》："道听而涂说，德之弃也。"

natural: Words and deeds the same

meaning.en: To practise what one preaches; one's actions match one's words.
meaning.zh: 说的和做的一样。

examples.zh: 父母要言行一致，才能教育好孩子。
examples.en: Parents must practise what they preach to bring up children well.

examples.zh: 他是一个言行一致的人。
examples.en: He's someone who walks the talk.

natural: Both sides perfectly satisfied

meaning.en: To satisfy both sides; the best of both worlds.
meaning.zh: 做一件事顾全到双方，使两方面都得到好处。

equivalents: have one's cake and eat it

examples.zh: 在家办公既能照顾孩子又能工作，真是两全其美。
examples.en: Working from home lets me look after the kids and work — the best of both worlds.

examples.zh: 我们想出了一个两全其美的办法。
examples.en: We came up with a win-win solution.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (两全其美的办法).

natural: The work falls short by one basket of earth

meaning.en: To fail just short of success; to fall at the last hurdle.
meaning.zh: 堆九仞高的山，只差一筐土而没能完成。比喻事情只差最后一点而没能成功。

equivalents: so near and yet so far
snatch defeat from the jaws of victory

examples.zh: 最后一题没做完，结果功亏一篑。
examples.en: He didn't finish the last question and fell at the last hurdle.

examples.zh: 坚持到最后，不要功亏一篑。
examples.en: Hang on to the end — don't fail just short of the finish.

story.en: The Book of Documents warns: "Building a mountain nine ren high, the work falls short for want of one basket of earth" (为山九仞，功亏一篑).
story.zh: 《尚书·旅獒》："为山九仞，功亏一篑。"

natural: Rich, beautiful and magnificent

meaning.en: Splendid and magnificent (of buildings).
meaning.zh: 形容房屋宏伟豪华。

examples.zh: 这座宫殿富丽堂皇。
examples.en: The palace is magnificent.

examples.zh: 酒店大堂装修得富丽堂皇。
examples.en: The hotel lobby is opulently decorated.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容建筑、装修。

natural: Heart focused and will devoted

meaning.en: Wholly absorbed; with complete concentration.
meaning.zh: 把心思全放在上面。形容一心一意，聚精会神。

examples.zh: 他专心致志地做作业，连饭都忘了吃。
examples.en: He was so absorbed in his homework that he forgot to eat.

examples.zh: 学习要专心致志，不能三心二意。
examples.en: Study with complete concentration — don't be half-hearted.

story.en: Mencius tells of the master Go player Yi Qiu teaching two pupils: one "concentrated his mind and devoted his will" (专心致志); the other daydreamed about shooting swans. The second learned far less — not for lack of brains.
story.zh: 弈秋教二人下棋，"其一人专心致志，惟弈秋之为听"，另一人想着射天鹅，结果学得不如前者。

usage.en: Usually adverbial. Very common in school writing.

natural: Acting lightly and moving rashly

meaning.en: To act rashly without careful thought.
meaning.zh: 不经慎重考虑，盲目行动。

examples.zh: 情况不明，大家不要轻举妄动。
examples.en: The situation is unclear — nobody act rashly.

examples.zh: 股市波动大，新手不宜轻举妄动。
examples.en: The stock market is volatile — beginners shouldn't rush in.

usage.en: Predicate. Usually in warnings: 不要/不敢轻举妄动.

natural: Unable to sit or stand at ease

meaning.en: Restless and on edge; unable to settle.
meaning.zh: 坐着站着都不安宁。形容心情紧张，情绪不安。

equivalents: like a cat on hot bricks

examples.zh: 等待手术结果时，家属坐立不安。
examples.en: Waiting for the results of the operation, the family were on pins and needles.

examples.zh: 孩子这么晚还没回家，妈妈坐立不安。
examples.en: The child still isn't home this late, and Mum can't settle.
